topics: 8. 20 Total 45 100 GUJARAT TECHNOLOGICAL UNIVERSITY Program Name: Diploma Engineering Level: Diploma Branch: Automation and Robotics Subject Code : DI04041031 Subject Name : Signals and Systems w.e.f. 2025-26 http://syllabus.gtu.ac.in/ Page 5 of 8 SUGGESTED PRACTICAL EXERCISES The following practical outcomes (PrOs) that are the sub-components of the COs. Some of the PrOs marked ‘*’ are compulsory, as they are crucial for that particular CO. These PrOs need to be attained at least at the ‘Precision Level’ of Dave’s Taxonomy related to ‘Psychomotor Domain’. Approx. Hrs. required
1. Study the simulation software for simulation of signals and system. 2Hrs
2. Classify CT/DT signals as energy/power, periodic/aperiodic, and even/odd based on mathematical definitions. 2Hrs
3. Generate standard test signals (impulse, step, ramp, parabolic, sinusoidal) using analytical or simulation tools. 2Hrs
4. Perform basic signal operations such as time shifting, scaling, and time reversal and observe their effects on signal shape. 4Hrs
5. Classify systems as linear/nonlinear, causal/non-causal, stable/unstable, and time-invariant/time-variant using given input-output relationships. 2Hrs
6. Compute the response of CT LTI systems using convolution integral. 2Hrs
7. Compute the response of DT LTI systems using convolution sum. 2Hrs
8. Verify LTI system properties such as linearity, time invariance, commutativity, associativity, and distributivity. 4Hrs
9. Determine the unit step response and derive system output using impulse response relationships. 2Hrs
10. Compute the DTFT of a discrete-time sequence and interpret its magnitude and phase spectrum. 4Hrs
11. Verify DTFT properties such as time-shifting, frequency-shifting, scaling, and time reversal using example signals. 4Hrs
12. Compute DFT and IDFT of sequences and interpret spectral components. 2Hrs
13. Verify DFT properties including periodicity, linearity, symmetry, and perform circular convolution. 4Hrs
14. Perform linear convolution using the DFT method. 2Hrs
15. Perform frequency-domain analysis of signals using DFT to extract magnitude and phase information. 2Hrs
16. Compute z-transform of standard signals and identify their regions of convergence (ROC). 2Hrs
